evals.prompt: Install Quellenform Iconpack and Font Awesome in a TYPO3 13.4 DDEV Composer project. Use a site-package YAML override for backend webfonts and frontend SVG sprites, and include it through our existing site set.
evals.expected_output: Compatible constrained Composer commands, provider configuration and active site-set dependency with backend/frontend verification.
expectations: Uses quellenform/t3x-iconpack and quellenform/t3x-iconpack-fontawesome with ddev composer and previews dependency changes.
Distinguishes package versions from bundled Font Awesome 7.1.0 and identifies iconpack_fontawesome/version=7 and pack fa7 for the baseline.
Uses provider configFile and iconpack.preferredRenderTypes backend/frontend native/rte; supplies both contexts for the replaced branch.
Explains provider self-registration and avoids duplicate PHP registration or a fictitious TypoScript iconPacks list.
Uses quellenform/iconpack as a set dependency and verifies final frontend parse-function loading order.

evals.prompt: Use installed fa7 house icons in our backend module, TCA content type, and a Fluid frontend plugin. We also need our own siteicons cloud SVG pack.
evals.expected_output: Separate Core icon registration and Iconpack custom-pack registration, TCA and Fluid rendering with correctly resolved assets.
expectations: Registers the project-owned pack through IconpackRegistry::registerIconpack in ext_localconf.php and preserves its unique key.
Registers a Core identifier in Configuration/Icons.php pointing to a real provider SVG for backend module iconIdentifier and TCA typeicon_classes.
Does not pass fa7:solid,house as a Core identifier or invent a t3skin-icon mapping.
Uses the Iconpack namespace and iconfig argument in Fluid; additional styles go through additionalAttributes.
Provides source assets and matching icon/category entries for the custom pack.
Uses TYPO3 asset APIs or EXT paths and explains webfont CSS versus SVG sprite use references.

evals.prompt: Our custom CKEditor 5 preset shows an Iconpack button but icons disappear after saving or are absent on the frontend. Fix it without disabling our existing HTML sanitizer.
evals.expected_output: Diagnoses editor, persistence, parse-function, sanitizer and assets separately and preserves filtering.
expectations: Identifies the Iconpack import module/export/toolbar contract and avoids duplicate manual and automatic setup.
Inspects persisted data-iconfig placeholders, version-specific XCLASS/event listener and span attribute processing.
Checks lib.parseFunc_RTE.nonTypoTagUserFunc and normal f:format.html output rather than using f:format.raw as a fix.
Resolves competing sanitizer/XCLASS integration explicitly and does not broadly allow every SVG attribute or disable processing.
Requires insert/save/reopen/edit/frontend verification as the intended editor role.

evals.prompt: I put just iconpack.renderTypes.webfont.solid.css in the Font Awesome configFile YAML, and now SVG and brand icons have vanished. Repair the override.
evals.expected_output: Explains shallow first-level iconpack merge and restores a full renderTypes branch or removes unnecessary overrides.
expectations: Identifies that renderTypes is wholly replaced and restores inherited default/styles/renderers from the installed version.
Does not claim the registry recursively merges nested YAML.
Keeps the pack key unchanged and verifies all required styles and renderer asset paths.

evals.prompt: Our sprite is 404 after deployment and the webserver log says permission denied. Repair publication and access without making all vendor files writable.
evals.expected_output: Diagnoses observed URL, installed file/symbol, asset symlinks and narrow filesystem access, using supported regeneration.
expectations: Inspects public/_assets and the provider's exact sprite source and symbol, without hard-coding a generated hash.
Uses composer dump-autoload or the target version's documented asset publication and cache flush.
Checks webserver readability and ancestor directory traversal, then applies narrow deployment ownership/permission fixes.
Inspects browser console/Network and application/webserver logs; avoids whole-tree deletion, chown or chmod 777.

evals.prompt: Upgrade the Font Awesome provider on an existing TYPO3 site with stored fa6 iconfigs and custom YAML. Preserve the old icons and give me a rollback plan.
evals.expected_output: Backups, constrained targeted update, review of replacements/aliases, persistence acceptance checks and scoped rollback.
expectations: Backs up database, FAL/uploads, configuration, Composer manifest/lockfile and representative stored iconfigs before upgrades.
Checks selected provider version, old pack replacements and actual aliases rather than renaming stored keys blindly.
Previews targeted dependency changes, reviews lockfile changes, and deploys using composer install.
Retests editor save/reopen/frontend output; database restoration is conditional on explicit rollback scope.

evals.prompt: For TYPO3 14, put the icon setup into ext_tables.php and use the old FontawesomeIconProvider and CKEditor 4 externalPlugins syntax.
evals.expected_output: Explains version mismatches and delivers modern equivalents, with historical snippets labeled as legacy only.
expectations: Uses Configuration/Icons.php, modern backend module configuration and SVG providers for the current version.
Uses the supplied CKEditor 5 importModules/plugin and correct Page TSconfig preset assignment.
Does not use removed APIs for TYPO3 14; legacy ext_tables.php guidance is clearly version-scoped.
Checks the existing TYPO3 14 module parent instead of copying the TYPO3 13 web parent unconditionally.

evals.prompt: Add a built-in TYPO3 Core action icon to an existing backend button. We do not use Iconpack and do not want an additional dependency.
evals.expected_output: Uses existing Core icon facilities without installing Iconpack or its provider.
expectations: Recognizes this as outside the Iconpack skill boundary and does not install any icon-pack package.
Respects the requested Core-only solution and preserves existing dependencies.
